title: Power BI Dataflows Failures by Dataflow
app: Power BI dataflow refresh events from the M365/Purview audit log and Admin API via HEC.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=powerbi:dataflow status="Failed"
| stats count as failures, latest(_time) as last_failure by dataflow_name
| where failures>0
| sort - failures
description: Counts Power BI Dataflows failures grouped by dataflow so operators immediately see which specific dataflows are broken rather than a single global failure number.
value: Object-level failure attribution turns a vague 'Power BI Dataflows is failing' alert into an actionable list of exactly what to fix first.
implementation: Ingest Power BI Dataflows failure events; schedule every 15 minutes and alert on failures for business-critical dataflows.
visualization: Table of dataflow by failure count and last failure time.
grandmaExplanation: We tell you exactly which parts of Power BI Dataflows are failing, not just that something is wrong, so the right thing gets fixed first.
